context_for_next_testing_agent: WordPress Page Placement Minion fully tested. All endpoints working: /api/wp-placement/templates (list and detail), /api/wp-placement/place (create and update modes), /api/wp-placement/log (list and detail), /api/wp-placement/drafts (list and detail), /api/wp-placement/stats, /api/wp-placement/settings. WordPress REST API is MOCKED - stores pages in MongoDB wp_mock_pages collection. Mock generates page IDs like 'wp-xxxxxxxx'. 3 templates available: standard_content, category_support, local_seo_landing. Placement generates Flatsome UX Builder shortcode markup in html_preview. Frontend has 4 tabs: Place Content, Placement Log, Drafts, Settings.

placement_endpoint.create: POST /api/wp-placement/place with mode=create - creates mock WP page
placement_endpoint.update: POST /api/wp-placement/place with mode=update and target_page_id - updates existing page
placement_endpoint.response: Returns placement record, page object, and html_preview with Flatsome shortcodes

frontend_tabs.place: Form with mode toggle, template selector, all content fields, related links, SEO fields
frontend_tabs.log: Placement history with CREATE/UPDATE badges, expandable details
frontend_tabs.drafts: List of mock WP pages with Update This button
frontend_tabs.settings: Toggles for preserve_slug, preserve_unmapped, flag_missing_cta, save_placement_log, default_status

mocked_api.WordPress REST API: MOCKED - wp_client.py uses MongoDB-backed mock instead of real WP API calls
mocked_api.to_enable_live: Set WP_SITE_URL, WP_USERNAME, WP_APP_PASSWORD in backend/.env
